resources.string: Connect an account only to execute Pro CHart signals. Credentials travel to the server over HTTPS and are never stored by the app.

What you enter here is setup input, not proof of a connection. Connected state comes only from the server and the venue; if verification does not arrive, execution stays pending rather than being guessed locally.
Create an LBank API key with only the permission you need: spot or futures. Withdrawal permission is not required. Saving a key does not mean the exchange has verified it.
LBank has no test environment. Any key saved here is a key to your real account, and any order placed from the app is executed with real money.
No exchange connection on this platform

This platform does not place orders from the app. A forex trading account is linked through copy trading — broker, server, account number and trading password are entered there — and there is nothing to set up here.
A forex account is not connected here. The forex side does not use API keys; a MetaTrader 5 account is linked through copy trading, and its form lives there.
Saved; the exchange has not verified it yet. Execution stays queued until LBank confirms.
Create the key in LBank without withdrawal permission. If the key is ever exposed, that is the one thing standing between it and your funds.
This account\'s details are cleared and any copying running from it stops. We do not keep those details anywhere, so reconnecting means entering them again.
